integrity: All integer-size assertions rest on the written combinatorial proof. Exhaustive finite verifiers provide limited cross-checks, not independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only bidirected bouquets of triangular petals; no longer cycles or arbitrary cactus digraphs are covered. The n=1 complex is disconnected and treated separately. Unindexed overlapping publications cannot be excluded.
title: Mixed-dimensional sphere wedges for bidirected friendship multipath complexes
